EMPLOYEE SPOTLIGHT

Voices from the team

I started my journey at Fido as a mobile engineer and, after two years, transitioned into a backend engineering role. This experience has given me the space to grow and make an impact across diverse areas and domains.

This journey has been incredibly fulfilling, allowing me to take ownership of projects that directly contribute to Fido’s mission of redefining the financial story for millions across Africa.

What makes Fido truly special is the people and the freedom to grow. Here, collaboration and meaningful contributions go hand in hand, and my work doesn’t just build software, it creates opportunities and transforms lives.

Yair Gadiel

Backend Engineer

Working at Fido has been a rewarding experience for me as a Collections Officer. I’ve grown significantly in my ability to handle diverse client situations, remain composed under pressure, and consistently deliver results while maintaining high standards.

The culture is open, supportive, and genuinely collaborative. Communication is transparent at all levels, and teamwork is actively encouraged, creating an environment where you truly feel valued, heard, and supported.

What truly sets Fido apart is its people-first approach combined with strong operational excellence. Employees are trusted to take initiative and make bold, impactful decisions.

Idah Buluka

Recovery Representative

There are so many things that make Fido special, but what stands out most for me is the quality of management. The leadership here genuinely invests in helping people grow, both personally and professionally.

I started as a Backend Engineer here at Fido and was promoted to Python Ghana Team Lead. This reflects the sort of workplace that fosters growth and development.

We do incredible engineering here, have a lot of fun while doing it, and everyone is always ready to support. Beyond the technical work, Fido is an amazing place for anyone looking for a sense of community alongside their career.

Moses Wuniche Alhassan

Python Ghana Team Lead
